(
	i/process
	i/fs
	i/fail
	i/stdio
	i/json
	i/int
	i/string
	i/bit_array
	(Some, None) = i/option
)

amount_value = (value) {
	json.as_string(value) |>
		(Some(text)) {
			int.parse(text) |>
				(Ok(amount) ? amount >= 0 && amount <= 1000) { Some(amount) }
				& (_) { None() }
		}
		& (_) { None() }
}

apply_record = (record, balance) {
	json.parse(record) |>
		(Ok(value)) {
			json.as_object(value) |>
				(Some(_)) {
					json.field(value, "op") |>
						(Some(op_value)) {
							json.as_string(op_value) |>
								(Some(op)) {
									op |>
										("reset") { (True(), 0) }
										& ("credit") {
											json.field(value, "amount") |>
												(Some(amount)) {
													amount_value(amount) |>
														(Some(n)) { (True(), balance + n) }
														& (_) { (False(), balance) }
												}
												& (_) { (False(), balance) }
										}
										& ("debit") {
											json.field(value, "amount") |>
												(Some(amount)) {
													amount_value(amount) |>
														(Some(n) ? balance >= n) { (True(), balance - n) }
														& (_) { (False(), balance) }
												}
												& (_) { (False(), balance) }
										}
										& (_) { (False(), balance) }
								}
								& (_) { (False(), balance) }
						}
						& (_) { (False(), balance) }
				}
				& (_) { (False(), balance) }
		}
		& (_) { (False(), balance) }
}

run_records = (records, balance, errors) {
	records |>
		([]) { stdio.print("TOTAL \(int.to_string(balance)) ERRORS \(int.to_string(errors))") }
		& ([record, ..rest]) {
			(success, next) = apply_record(record, balance)
			success |>
				(True()) {
					stdio.print("OK \(int.to_string(next))")
					run_records(rest, next, errors)
				}
				& (False()) {
					stdio.print("ERROR \(int.to_string(balance))")
					run_records(rest, balance, errors + 1)
				}
		}
}

run_text = (text) {
	parts = string.split(text, "\n")
	{ string.ends_with(text, "\n") } |>
		(True()) {
			run_records(list.drop(parts, 1), 0, 0)
		}
		& (False()) { run_records(parts, 0, 0) }
}

main = () {
	process.args() |>
		([path]) {
			fail.catch(() { fs.read_file(path) }) |>
				(Ok(bytes)) {
					bit_array.to_string(bytes) |>
						(Ok(text)) { run_text(text) }
						& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
				}
				& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
		}
		& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
}
